name: popsicle
headline: Product-Marketing-Agency - Generate Marketing
short_description: Create product marketing visuals and content with a multi-agent system. Ideal for marketing teams, agencies, and businesses needing scalable content creation. Integrates with design tools and CMS platforms.
author: akaraf985

sections.overview:
Product-Marketing-Agency is a multi-agent AI skill designed to streamline product marketing content and visual creation. It leverages multiple specialized agents working together to generate marketing materials at scale, making it well-suited for marketing teams, agencies, and businesses with ongoing content needs. The skill integrates with design tools and CMS platforms to fit into existing workflows.
Generate product launch marketing materials and visuals for multiple campaigns simultaneously
Create consistent marketing content across design tools and content management systems
Produce scalable social media and promotional visuals for agency clients
Develop product positioning content and marketing collateral for business teams
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/akaraf985/Product-Marketing-Agency`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a product marketing agency for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Create a comprehensive product marketing campaign including visuals and content. Use the following product details: [PRODUCT]. Generate a campaign brief, social media posts, email content, and design concepts. Ensure the content is engaging, on-brand, and tailored to [TARGET_AUDIENCE].
```
